## Browse by Season

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

user <- "barts78"

# Season -> repo name on your account
season_repos <- c(
  "Season 2324" = "DrBarts2324",
  "Season 2425" = "DrBarts2425",
  "Season 2526" = "DrBarts2526",
  "Season 2627" = "DrBarts2627"
)

# Optional: per-season thumbnails (fallback if not provided)
default_thumb <- "Images/Premier-League-ball.png"

thumb_map <- c(
  "Season 25" = "Images/Season25.png",
  "Season 26" = "Images/Season26.png",
  "Season 27" = "Images/Season26.png"
)

pick_thumb <- function(season) {
  thumb <- unname(thumb_map[season])
  if (is.na(thumb) || length(thumb) == 0) default_thumb else thumb
}

# Sort seasons numerically (25, 26, ...)
season_names <- names(season_repos)
season_nums  <- as.numeric(sub("^Season\\s+", "", season_names))
ord <- order(season_nums)

season_names <- season_names[ord]
season_repos  <- unname(season_repos[ord])

# Build cards
cards <- vapply(seq_along(season_names), function(i) {
  season <- season_names[i]
  repo   <- season_repos[i]

  # If each season repo serves the season hub at the repo root:
  url <- sprintf("https://%s.github.io/%s/", user, repo)

  # If instead you keep a "Season xx/" folder inside each repo, use this:
 url <- sprintf("https://%s.github.io/%s/%s/", user, repo, utils::URLencode(season))

  thumb <- pick_thumb(season)

  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-4">\n',
      '  <div class="card season-card">\n',
      '    <div class="season-card-media">\n',
      '      <img src="%s" class="card-img-top img-fluid" alt="%s thumbnail">\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '    <div class="card-body">\n',
      '      <h3><a href="%s">%s</a></h3>\n',
      '      <div class="text-muted">Browse dashboards &amp; visuals</div>\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '  </div>\n',
      '</div>\n'
    ),
    thumb, season, url, season
  )
}, character(1))

output <- paste0(
  '<div class="grid">\n',
  paste(cards, collapse = "\n"),
  "\n</div>\n"
)

knitr::asis_output(output)

```
